translations.web: He brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his household, having believed in God.
translations.bsb: Then he brought them into his home and set a meal before them. So he and all his household rejoiced that they had come to believe in God.
translations.kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
translations.asv: And he brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his house, having believed in God.
